title: Mean time to triage
summary: Time between a vuln_intake finding entering the playbook and the triage step closing with an outcome. Measures responsiveness of the intake workflow, independent of remediation backlog.

target.rationale: Operator target for business-hours triage SLA.

measurement.formula: mean( triage_finding.completed_at - start.completed_at ) over playbook runs in window.

inputs.name: playbook_run
inputs.description: duration from workflow start to completion of the triage step
